nodes.label: ML-DSA-87 Module-Lattice Digital Signature Algorithm
nodes.description: NIST FIPS 204 Category 5 post-quantum digital signature mechanism parameter set based on the hard problem of Module Learning With Errors (M-LWE) and Module Short Integer Solution (M-SIS).

nodes.label: Compute Express Link (CXL) 3.1 Dynamic Capacity Device (DCD) Architecture
nodes.description: CXL 3.1 memory disaggregation specification permitting fine-grained allocation and deallocation of unbacked physical memory regions to hosts dynamically at runtime without rebooting.

nodes.label: CAMeL Tools Morphological Part-of-Speech Tagging Engine
nodes.description: Disambiguation pipeline within CAMeL Tools assigning fine-grained morphological features and part-of-speech (POS) tags to Arabic words based on context.

nodes.label: W3C RDF-star Data Model and SPARQL-star Specification
nodes.description: Extension to RDF 1.1 allowing statements to be made about other RDF triples (quoted triples) without full reification overhead, supporting edge-property semantics in graph databases.

nodes.label: GraphBLAS Masked Breadth-First Search (BFS) Traversal Kernel
nodes.description: Algebraic implementation of BFS level-synchronous graph traversal executing vector-matrix multiplication v^T * A with complement mask to track visited nodes across iterations.
